basic_info.description: Fantastic North Beach Location!   Chic one bedroom TIC (Tenancy in Common) originally developed by Master Builders in an Edwardian five-unit building! Located on Mason Street at Union Street, a classic San Francisco neighborhood.  Short walking distance to Financial District, North Beach Cafes and Restaurants, Washington Square, Chinatown and Russian Hill. Open floorplan of Living/Dining and Kitchen.   Property has radiant floor heating, in-unit laundry, and walk-in shower with skylight.  Beautiful hardwood floors, natural stone finishes and a lovely private garden! Perfect for entertaining or relaxing at home.
